messages:
jordan (merchantgateway): heads-up — starting ~06:10 UTC we saw a flood of 429s for a set of eu customers. endpoints affected: /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. failures are bursty, not sustained. grabbing sample headers now.

emma (support): thanks — can you paste the exact response headers and one request id so we can trace? also which org and app id (obfuscated) and region?

jordan (merchantgateway): sample from our client logs:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: rg-7a9b-zz1
x-rate-limit-rpm: 1000
x-rate-limit-rpm-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-tpm: 200000
x-rate-limit-tpm-remaining: 198500
retry-after: 3
org: merchantgateway-prod-eu
app-id: mgw-checkout

ryan (eng-sre): pulled gateway traces for rg-7a9b-zz1. Throttles are firing at the RPM layer. TPM is plenty. We're seeing short, high-concurrency spikes (~15s) that zero the rolling-minute RPM bucket, which results in 429s until the rolling window frees tokens. Not an auth or infra OOM.

maya (eng-runtime): quick ingress snapshot for the app: 06:09:58 -> 1,200 req/min equivalent (measured as 200 requests in 10s), 06:10:12 -> back to 140 req/min, 06:10:40 -> ~35 req/min. So short fanout. CPU looks fine.

jordan (merchantgateway): root cause on our side: a downstream webhook retry storm from PaymentPartnerX retriggered checkout validations. Our server had 3 retries with no jitter and all retries were synchronous.

emma (support): for immediate relief we can: 1) apply a short RPM uplift for your org; 2) recommend immediate client-side fix; 3) enable a burst smoothing grace on our rate limiter (needs a config push). Which do you want?

jordan (merchantgateway): please apply the uplift — we're hotfixing client retries now (adding jitter + idempotency keys). Also want guidance for safer retry config.

ryan (eng-sre): mitigation options (summarized):
- Client: change retries to exponential backoff with full jitter and cap concurrency. Example:
```
backoff_ms = base_ms * (2 ** attempt)
wait = random(0, backoff_ms)
```
- Honor `retry-after` header.
- Short-term: we can 2x your RPM quota for 60 minutes; will auto-revert.
- Infra-side: enable a small token-bucket smoothing window for brief spikes (non-trivial config change).

maya (eng-runtime): proposed actions:
- apply temp RPM uplift to org merchantgateway-prod-eu at 06:24 UTC for 60m
- add a dashboard alert for RPM > 75% sustained for 5m
- plan a burst-smoothing toggle if spikes recur

ryan (eng-sre): applying uplift now: quota.rpm.merchantgateway-prod-eu set to 2000 (from 1000) — will auto-revert at 07:24 UTC.

deploy-bot: quota update applied by ryan — id q-update-19283 — effective immediately

jordan (merchantgateway): patch deployed at 06:35 UTC. switched retries to jittered exponential backoff, added `Idempotency-Key` to checkout calls. Confirming via replay.

maya (eng-runtime): monitoring: after the uplift + patch the 06:36–06:46 window shows RPM under limit. occasional single-digit 429s during replay bursts but no systemic failures.

emma (support): please run a 10m validation and confirm you see normal behavior before we close. We'll also create an internal KB with recommended SDK defaults and how to request quota uplifts.

jordan (merchantgateway): running 10m replay now — looks stable. thanks for the fast help. can you include a note in the KB on programmatic uplift requests (we'll automate if needed)?

ryan (eng-sre): will add runbook entry: how to request uplift via support + API with safe limits and typical rollback. Also adding a local repro snippet for devs:
```
# quick burst test, do not target prod
for i in {1..500}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/chat &\nsleep 0.01\ndone
```
Notes: use staging with mirrored quotas.

emma (support): KB draft created at support/internal/kb/retries-and-quota-guidance.md. I'll attach link after review.

jordan (merchantgateway): incident resolved on our side. leaving thread open for KB + runbook tasks. thanks again :thumbsup:

ryan (eng-sre): closing checklist: [x] uplift applied & auto-revert scheduled, [x] client patch deployed, [ ] KB published (emma), [ ] add SDK default retry change (devex/product).

ops-bot: follow-up reminder scheduled in 48h to confirm KB publication and runbook additions.
